content_item_blocked_needs_reason.name: content_item_blocked_needs_reason
content_item_blocked_needs_reason.value: status <> 'blocked' OR blocked_reason IS NOT NULL

content_item_cancelled_needs_reason.name: content_item_cancelled_needs_reason
content_item_cancelled_needs_reason.value: status <> 'cancelled' OR cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL

content_item_changes_requested_needs_gat.name: content_item_changes_requested_needs_gate
content_item_changes_requested_needs_gat.value: status <> 'changes_requested' OR change_request_gate IS NOT NULL

publication_published_needs_url_time_pub.name: publication_published_needs_url_time_publisher
publication_published_needs_url_time_pub.value:
"publication_record"."status" <> 'published' OR (
        "publication_record"."actual_published_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "publication_record"."published_url" IS NOT NULL
        AND "publication_record"."publisher_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

publication_pending_clears_published_fie.name: publication_pending_clears_published_fields
publication_pending_clears_published_fie.value:
"publication_record"."status" <> 'pending' OR (
        "publication_record"."actual_published_at" IS NULL
        AND "publication_record"."published_url" IS NULL
        AND "publication_record"."publisher_id" IS NULL
      )

social_profile_metric_counts_non_negativ.name: social_profile_metric_counts_non_negative
social_profile_metric_counts_non_negativ.value:
follower_count >= 0
        AND (following_count IS NULL OR following_count >= 0)
        AND (media_count IS NULL OR media_count >= 0)
        AND (likes_count IS NULL OR likes_count >= 0)
        AND (reach IS NULL OR reach >= 0)
        AND (views IS NULL OR views >= 0)
        AND (engaged_accounts IS NULL OR engaged_accounts >= 0)
        AND (interactions IS NULL OR interactions >= 0)

agency_storage_config_key_versions_valid.name: agency_storage_config_key_versions_valid
agency_storage_config_key_versions_valid.value: ("agency_storage_config"."access_key_key_version" IS NULL OR "agency_storage_config"."access_key_key_version" BETWEEN 1 AND 32767) AND ("agency_storage_config"."secret_access_key_key_version" IS NULL OR "agency_storage_config"."secret_access_key_key_version" BETWEEN 1 AND 32767)

agency_storage_config_owned_fields_valid.name: agency_storage_config_owned_fields_valid
agency_storage_config_owned_fields_valid.value: "agency_storage_config"."mode" <> 'agency_owned' OR ("agency_storage_config"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("agency_storage_config"."account_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND "agency_storage_config"."bucket_override" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_storage_config"."endpoint_override" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_storage_config"."access_key_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_storage_config"."access_key_last_four" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_storage_config"."access_key_key_version" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_storage_config"."secret_access_key_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_storage_config"."secret_access_key_last_four" IS NOT NULL AND "agency_storage_config"."secret_access_key_key_version" IS NOT NULL)

storage_object_dimensions_nonnegative.name: storage_object_dimensions_nonnegative
storage_object_dimensions_nonnegative.value: ("storage_object"."width" IS NULL OR "storage_object"."width" > 0) AND ("storage_object"."height" IS NULL OR "storage_object"."height" > 0) AND ("storage_object"."duration_ms" IS NULL OR "storage_object"."duration_ms" >= 0)
